4.text: In times of war a fight with lances was a most common occurrence, as

5.text: may be inferred from episodes in several tales. A certain degree of skill was

6.text: displayed in such fights, and young men would assiduously practise fighting

7.text: with the lance as well as running and carrying heavy stones. However, the

8.text: chief aim of this practice was to increase the strength of the arms. “He

9.text: practised so long, that the shaft of the lance became, in his hands, as pliable

10.text: as a strip of skin,” says one tale about a hero. As recently as fifty years

11.text: ago, fighting with lances, as well as wrestling and
